Bass: Lineout (A14) Desktop release

We are opening the gates for our next iteration of Bass OS builds (Lineout/Submix), and the initial releases are being uploaded one by one to our website.

Check out the downloads section:
https://bassos.navotpala.tech/#downloads

Install Documentation: https://docs.blisscolabs.dev/installation/x86_64-v2/bass_os_aio_android-13-15_install_process/

(Make sure to check out the rest of the documentation site for the features, apps, and interface information)
